load_from_disk: load a DeepMind Hard Eight environment from a local disk path using EnvironmentSettings
load_from_docker: load a DeepMind Hard Eight environment from a Docker container using EnvironmentSettings
EnvironmentSettings: create an EnvironmentSettings NamedTuple with seed, level_name, width, height, and num_action_repeats
HardEightTasksEnv_step: step the Hard Eight environment with an action repeated N times and accumulate rewards
connect_to_environment: connect to a running dm_hard_eight environment over gRPC with the given port and settings
